programs.description: A woman faces several obstacles in life after her mother, an ardent devotee of a goddess, is transformed into a stone statue.
At Dr Parchure's farmhouse party, a power cut leads to an unexpected situation. The curious guests eagerly investigate the mystery, turning a festive evening into a thrilling hunt for truth.
Arundhati selflessly dedicates her life to her family, but when she realizes her sacrifices are unappreciated, she embarks on a journey of self-discovery to reclaim her identity and independence.
Shalan kills her stalker and convinces Sakharam, a stranger, to pose as her husband to evade the law. However, he gets frustrated by her arrogance and decides to teach her a lesson.

A couple turns murderers out of greed and uses pretence and lies to enter a wealthy family. Years later, their youngest daughter-in-law learns about their past crimes and plans to teach them a lesson.
When the evil puppet Tatya Vinchu is revived once again, he searches for his dead ventriloquist creator's son, Aditya, in order to attain a human form.
From pursuing his career as a singer to marrying the love of his life, a boy belonging to a quaint village goes against great odds to achieve excellence and earn fame as Shahir Sable.
